turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You gave Owen a zero. I want to know who decided that, and when.
I'm fine standing. Who decided on the zero?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Save it. On what basis did you enter that zero?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
Agree the zero stands? No. You haven't shown me anything yet.
